messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "track prescriptions"
set: ["track prescriptions", "pregnancy registry may be used to track effects on baby", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby", "prescription drug monitoring program", "prescription", "follow directions on prescription label", "check the prescribing information", "prescription medication", "inform doctor or pharmacist about all medications currently taken or recently stopped taking", "read instructions for use with prescription", "Prescription only", "follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets", "follow directions on prescription label carefully", "tell doctor about all prescription medications", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "keep list of medicines to show doctor and pharmacist when getting new medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
